nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Activate this workflow manually when GTA VI pre-orders go live. Expected: November 2026. Do NOT set a cron trigger — this is a one-shot blast.

nodes.name: Build Blast Content
nodes.notes: Update all REPLACE_ values before activating. CDKeys and Eneba affiliate links give 5-8% commission vs Amazon's 1-3%.

parameters.name: post
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ profile_ids: ['REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_X', 'REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_IG', 'REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_REDDIT'], text: $json.xPost, scheduled_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Publer — Blast All Channels
nodes.notes: Posts to X, Instagram, and Reddit simultaneously. Add your profile IDs.

parameters.name: post
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: $json.beehiivSubject, content: $json.beehiivBody, status: 'confirmed', audience: 'free', send_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Beehiiv — Send Launch Email
nodes.notes: status: 'confirmed' sends immediately to all subscribers. Change to 'draft' to review first.

parameters.name: embeds
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ title: '🎮 GTA VI Pre-orders Live', url: $json.buyPage, color: 16711680, description: `Best price: ${$json.bestPrice}`, fields: [{ name: 'CDKeys', value: $json.cdkeys, inline: true }, { name: 'Amazon US', value: $json.amazonUS, inline: true }], footer: { text: 'GTAVI.AI — Economy Intelligence' } }]) }}

meta.description: One-shot manual blast for GTA VI pre-order launch. Posts to X/Instagram/Reddit via Publer, sends Beehiiv email, posts Discord announcement. All channels fire simultaneously. Activate when pre-orders go live (expected Nov 2026).

placeholders.REPLACE_PUBLER_TOKEN: Publer Dashboard → Settings → API → Copy token
placeholders.REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_X: Publer Dashboard → Profiles → X → Copy profile ID
placeholders.REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_IG: Publer Dashboard → Profiles → Instagram → Copy profile ID
placeholders.REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_REDDIT: Publer Dashboard → Profiles → Reddit → Copy profile ID
placeholders.REPLACE_BEEHIIV_API_KEY: Beehiiv Dashboard → Settings → API Keys → Generate
placeholders.REPLACE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: Discord → Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL
placeholders.REPLACE_GTA6_AMAZON_US: Amazon Associates → Search 'GTA VI' → Get affiliate link
placeholders.REPLACE_GTA6_AMAZON_UK: Amazon Associates UK → Search 'GTA VI' → Get affiliate link
placeholders.REPLACE_CDKEYS_AFFILIATE: CDKeys affiliate programme → Get your tracking URL
placeholders.REPLACE_ENEBA_AFFILIATE: Eneba affiliate programme → Get your tracking URL
